item.title: Best pictures from across the UK as Britons party into 2026

item.title: Motorists to face higher bills today as Ofgem energy price cap impacts charging costs for millions
item.description: Drivers have been warned of the new Ofgem energy price cap launching today, which could hit millions of electric car owners with higher home-charging bills.As of today, January 1, the revised price cap of £1,758 will be in effect and remain in place until the end of March, when the regulator will re-examine the amount people pay. item.title: 'Several' people killed after explosion inside nightclub at popular winter tourist hotspot
item.description: Several people are said to have died after an explosion ripped through a bar in a popular Swiss ski resort.The blast happened at 1.30am local time just as revellers were ringing in the New Year at the Constellation bar.Swiss outlet Blick reports the blaze may have begun when fireworks were let off inside during a concert.Social media footage shows scenes of the subsequent fire from outside the venue - with crowds rushing out and emergency services rushing in.
